bounded_statement: The selected result claims an occurrence rate for all 96 scheduled stations but divides the 18 observed occurrences by only the 72 stations retained after screening.

counterevidence_considered.description: The report transparently accounts for the full 96 stations, the 72 retained stations, the 24 omissions, and the retained-set numerator; this was considered as possible evidence that the intended estimand was conditional, but it does not change the explicitly complete-network target and claim.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Scheduled stations (planned units): 96
Stations passing the signal screen: 72
Stations omitted by the signal screen: 24
Occurrences observed among the retained stations: 18

counterevidence_considered.description: An approved deviation could potentially have altered the target or denominator, but the report states that none exists.

source_refs.quoted_text: No protocol amendment and no approved method deviation exists for this analysis.

evidence.description: The stated task requires one rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Build a compact coastal-station workflow that reports one occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

evidence.description: The visible data include scheduled stations omitted by screening with unobserved occurrence flags, so the retained set is a strict subset of the scheduled domain.
The report explicitly defines the target population as all 96 scheduled stations.

source_refs.quoted_text: Target population: all 96 scheduled coastal stations in the survey network.

evidence.description: The selected report explicitly uses the 72 retained stations as its exposure denominator while labeling the resulting rate as applying to the entire scheduled network.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Exposure denominator: the 72 stations retained after the signal screen.
[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: 18 occurrences divided by 72 retained stations = 0.25 (25.00 occurrences per 100 stations).

evidence.description: The workflow constructs the same retained-subset denominator and complete-network claim directly.

source_refs.quoted_text:
DENOMINATOR_LINE = f'Exposure denominator: the {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} stations retained after the signal screen.' + LF
SELECTED_LINE = f'[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: {OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES} occurrences divided by {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} retained stations = {SELECTED_RATE_FRACTION} ({SELECTED_RATE_PERCENT} occurrences per 100 stations).' + LF

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the mismatch by checking whether the scientific target or selected claim was explicitly conditional on passing the screen, or whether an approved deviation authorized that target change. The task and report instead specify the entire scheduled network, while the report states that no amendment or approved deviation exists; therefore the retained denominator cannot be reconciled with the declared complete-domain claim.

root_cause: The workflow hard-codes SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS as the selected result's exposure denominator even though the task and report define the target as the complete scheduled network.
